announcements.title: New: the Orpheus engine
announcements.body:
Meet Orpheus, Murmur's new engine: full tracks in seconds, up to 6 minutes, with a richer sound. Still made entirely on your iPhone. Powered by Stability AI.

One-time 2.1 GB download. Your tracks and the Classic engine stay.

announcements.title: What's new in Murmur
announcements.body:
• Faster music generation, now running fully on the Neural Engine
• Your first track is free, start to finish
• Long tracks can now finish, and progress is saved if the app closes
• Fixes for loading and setup issues
